difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the commutativity of a square and triangle diagram built from the graph correspondence, its transpose, the diagonal correspondences and the fundamental classes of two equidimensional smooth projective schemes (statement lines 776-793). The proof (proof lines 794-827) translates the diagram into two pullbacks of fundamental cycles, computes both routes using the description of correspondences of graphs, and identifies both with the graph of the morphism. H3: a diagram chase carried out in full.
